facts.fact: On 2025-11-21 in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso's ARCEP signed an agreement with Ghana's regulator on free roaming between Burkina Faso and Ghana (local tariffs for travellers), in the presence of the digital ministers' delegations; the minister said it will be extended progressively to Mali and Niger.

On 2025-11-21 in Ouagadougou, ARCEP signed with its Ghana, Mali and Niger counterparts a protocol on border frequency coordination (preferential frequencies, interference prevention, 15 km coordination zones each side of borders).
